meta.note: Items with meta.access "free" install without a key. Items with meta.access "paid" need a license key and return 401 without one.

items.name: agent-fleet
items.title: Agent Fleet
items.description: Every lead agent you have running, in one column, with the sub-agents of the one you pick drawn out beside it. Lines grow from the lead to each helper, a helper's own helpers hang below it, and a card that needs you gets an Answer button.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: agent-handoff
items.title: Agent Handoff
items.description: A team of agents in a row, each with what it is doing now, and the queues between them. Work handed from one agent to the next glides from queue to queue; the newest items sit on top and the rest fade out under the edge.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: agent-inbox
items.title: Agent Inbox
items.description: Every agent run in one place, sorted into Waiting on you, Running and Done. Flip between a board and a list and the cards glide to their new places; a run that changes state glides to its new column.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: agent-marks
items.title: Agent Marks
items.description: The shared pieces of the agent components: marks for models and tools, an avatar tile, a row of tool marks, and a status pill with its spinner.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: agent-run
items.title: Agent Run
items.description: One agent at work, small enough for a corner: the step it is on with its clock, a bar with a segment per step and a light that runs along the current one, the last steps it finished, and buttons to pause or stop it. Folds down to its header and bar.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: agent-steps
items.title: Agent Steps
items.description: An agent's run as a timeline. Finished steps tick and join up along a rail, the current one spins with a live clock, and what it is doing right now branches off beneath it, one line at a time. A step that waits on you rings in amber and asks to be approved or denied.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: agent-tree
items.title: Agent Tree
items.description: An orchestrator and the agents it handed work to, joined by one bracket. Each agent with helpers of its own opens them below it on a branch, and folds them away again.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: bot-avatar
items.title: Bot Avatar
items.description: A flat little character for an agent: a coloured circle, squircle, triangle or pill with two tall eyes that glance away and blink now and then, each bot on its own clock. Three of them gather into a group for a shared thread.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: confirmation
items.title: Confirmation
items.description: The agent asking for a yes before it does something: run a command, start a plan, touch a file. One line says what and why, two buttons answer, and once answered it settles into a quiet record of the decision.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: decision-tree
items.title: Decision Tree
items.description: A question an agent can't answer alone, with its options laid out as branches. The agent's suggestion is marked; choosing a branch glides its follow-up in beside it, and the numbers on the keys pick from the keyboard. Several waiting decisions page with the arrow keys.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: image-generation
items.title: Image Generation
items.description: A placeholder that becomes the picture. A grid of soft tiles moves in a pattern of your choosing while the image is made, takes on its colours the moment it arrives, and swells from the middle until the tiles close into the photograph.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: judge-bracket
items.title: Judge Bracket
items.description: Candidate fixes play off in a bracket. Scores roll in as each match is judged, winners carry forward along solid lines while losers dim behind dotted ones, and the two finalists sit side by side for the last call.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Sixteen dots in a square that swell and light up in a pattern: a scan, a wave, a twinkle, an orbit, a pulse, a spiral, rain or rising bars. Round, soft-cornered or square, in the text colour or a palette of your own, and small enough to sit beside a line of text.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A line in a conversation that is not a message: what the agent is doing, what it did, or a labelled break.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A transcript that only moves when the reader asks it to. A new prompt rises to the top with the end of the last answer still in view, the reply streams into the space below it, and scrolling away is respected until you jump back.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: model-fallback
items.title: Model Fallback
items.description: One request routed down a list of models. A rate-limited model turns red and its wire goes dashed, the next one lights up with a signal flowing towards it, and the response node answers once a model gets through.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: orb
items.title: Orb
items.description: An orb of fine dots that shows what an agent is doing. The same dots rearrange for each step it goes through: listening, thinking, searching, connecting, composing, imagining, shaping and speaking, each with a movement that means something. It works at 20 pixels beside a line of text and at any size on its own.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: outline
items.title: Outline
items.description: The questions asked so far, as a rail of marks at the edge of the transcript. The mark for the turn you are reading is longer; rest on the rail and the questions fan out beside their marks; pick one and the transcript glides back to it.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: plan
items.title: Plan
items.description: A plan the agent proposes before it acts: a title, a line on what it changes, the scope in a few words, and numbered steps that arrive one by one with the files each one touches. Start it and the steps tick off as the work runs; ask for changes and say what should change without leaving the card.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: Where a prompt is written. It takes files from a picker, a drop or a paste, records voice notes with a glow that swells with your voice, opens a menu for / commands and @ mentions as you type them, picks a model, and turns its send button into a stop button while the answer streams.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: An agent asking before it acts, one question at a time, in the same tinted bubble as the rest of the conversation. Pick with a click or the number key shown at the end of each row, and a single answer moves on by itself; a strip of steps shows how far along you are, the card glides to the height of each question as one dissolves into the next, and once sent it keeps a record of what was said.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: The model thinking out loud, kept to a small window. While it thinks the latest lines scroll up in steps under a shimmering label; when it is done it folds away into how long it took, and opens again to read in full.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: response
items.title: Response
items.description: An answer as it streams. Each word comes out of a slight blur as it arrives, numbered citations become source chips you can hover, and the actions underneath copy, rate and retry.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: shimmer
items.title: Shimmer
items.description: A band of light that passes over text while something is working. It is made from the text’s own colour, so it suits any text and anything inside it, icons included.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: Where an answer came from. A row of site icons, a count and the first domains, opening into the full list: numbered to match the citations in the text, each with its site, title and a line of what it said.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: suggestions
items.title: Suggestions
items.description: Prompts to try next, as pills or as a list of follow-ups. They arrive one after another so the eye reads them in order.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: tasks
items.title: Tasks
items.description: The to-do list an agent is working through. A ring fills as tasks finish, the one in progress shimmers over the file it is touching, a finished one keeps what it changed at its side, and folded it is a single line naming what is happening now. It sits best in a tray rising out of the prompt input.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool Call
items.description: What an agent did, one row per step. A step shimmers while it runs and draws a tick when it finishes; rows with output open to show it, and a group folds the whole run into one line.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: turn
items.title: Turn
items.description: One exchange: what you asked, then what the agent did and said. The prompt is a bubble on the right with its attachments above it and copy and edit on hover; the reply is a column the other pieces stack into, in the order they happened.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: dither-field
items.title: Dither Field
items.description: A drifting field printed through an 8×8 ordered dither. Inks are mixed in OKLab from the page colour toward your accent, so it follows light and dark mode, and each cell snaps to whole device pixels so it stays crisp. The pointer is a lamp that thickens the ink.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: glass
items.title: Glass
items.description: Soft light seen through textured glass. A body of colour rises from below, mixed from your accents and the page behind it, so it follows light and dark mode and any theme. The glass is reeded, blocked, glazed or a mosaic, and the pointer presses the light aside.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: silk
items.title: Silk
items.description: Light folded like cloth. A slow field of fabric is shaded from a five-colour ramp mixed in OKLab, so every fold passes through colours that belong to the palette, with a gloss along each crest. The pointer presses into it.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: chat-divider
items.title: Chat Divider
items.description: The quiet structure of a conversation: a line for each day, a line where the unread messages start, and a small note when someone joins or leaves.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: Where a message is written. It grows with what you type, Enter sends, and the microphone turns into a send button as soon as there is something to send.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: message-status
items.title: Message Status
items.description: Where a sent message has got to: sending, sent, delivered, read, or not delivered. The clock fades into a tick, a second tick joins it, and read takes on colour.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One message in a conversation: who sent it, the bubble, and what is said underneath. Messages from the same person run together, replies quote what they answer, and reactions sit on the bubble’s edge.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: poll
items.title: Poll
items.description: A question with a few answers, sent as a message. Tap one and the bars fill to each answer’s share, the percentages roll into place and the people who chose it appear beside it. Let people pick several, close it when the time is up, and it settles into the final count.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: reaction-picker
items.title: Reaction Picker
items.description: A row of emoji to react with. Each one lifts and grows a little under the pointer, and the ones you have already used are marked.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: Presence with a shape for each status: a glowing dot that pulses when online, a crescent for away, a bar for do not disturb and a ring for offline. Changing status springs it into the new shape. StatusPill puts the dot and its name in a tinted chip.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing Indicator
items.description: Someone is writing. Three dots that rise and settle in turn inside a bubble, or a small pill that names who is typing.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: voice-note
items.title: Voice Note
items.description: A recorded message in a chat bubble. The waveform fills as it plays, and the play button turns into pause in one movement. Pair it with Voice Recorder and it shows the shape of what was actually said.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: voice-recorder
items.title: Voice Recorder
items.description: A record button that grows into a voice note as you speak. A warm glow drifts round its edge and swells with your voice, the bars build up beside it, and stopping hands back the audio with its real waveform.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid-column-menu
items.title: Data Grid Column Menu
items.description: The menu behind each Data Grid header: sort either way or as a second key, pin to the start or the end, reset the width and hide the column. The header's own label is the trigger.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid-filter
items.title: Data Grid Filter
items.description: The Data Grid's filter bar. A popover picks a column and its value, and each filter becomes a chip whose operator and value can be changed on their own. Text, number, date, option and multi-option columns each get their own editor.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid-footer
items.title: Data Grid Footer
items.description: The strip under the Data Grid: which rows are showing, how many are selected, the count, sum, average, minimum and maximum of the selected cells, and paging with a rows-per-page select.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid-icons
items.title: Data Grid Icons
items.description: The stroke icons the Data Grid's parts share, drawn on a 16px grid in the current text colour.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid-row-controls
items.title: Data Grid Row Controls
items.description: The controls that go in a Data Grid's own columns: a select-all and a per-row checkbox with shift-click ranges, a disclosure arrow for rows with sub-rows, and a row menu with your actions, copy and pinning.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid-selection-bar
items.title: Data Grid Selection Bar
items.description: A toolbar that rises over the foot of the Data Grid while rows are selected, with export, pin, an optional delete and a way to clear the selection.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid-toolbar
items.title: Data Grid Toolbar
items.description: The strip above the Data Grid: a title and row count, a search field that opens from an icon, the column visibility menu, and a menu for CSV export, print and resetting the layout.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: A spreadsheet-style table on TanStack Table, assembled from the data pieces: toolbar with search and column picker, typed filters, the grid, a selection bar and a pager. Sort, pin, resize, reorder and hide columns from each header; select rows or drag out a range of cells and copy it; edit in place and save or discard the batch. Only the rows on screen are in the page, so three hundred rows cost the same as thirty.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: dissolve
items.title: Dissolve
items.description: Make an element come apart and drift away, in one of five looks: smoke, dust, pixels, vapor or embers. An edge crosses it, and what it passes breaks off in the element’s own colours, drawn sharp at screen resolution, then lifts away and thins out to nothing.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: dither
items.title: Dither
items.description: Light drawn in two colours. A slow field of light, or a photograph, rendered the way a one-bit screen would: every dot is ink or nothing, and the shades are made by how thickly the ink is scattered. The pointer is a lamp.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: engraving
items.title: Engraving
items.description: A picture cut in lines, like a banknote portrait. Parallel lines swell where the image is dark and thin out where it is light, bending a little over its forms, and a second set crosses them in the deepest shadows. The pointer is a loupe.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: glow
items.title: Glow
items.description: Soft coloured light that drifts around the inside edge of an element. It follows any rounded shape, brightens and quickens with a level you give it, such as a voice or typing, and spins up and coasts to a stop instead of switching.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: pixel-field
items.title: Pixel Field
items.description: A field of pixels that blooms under the pointer. Inside a card or a button, small squares spread out from where the pointer came in, keep twinkling, and draw back to where it left. Costs nothing when nobody is touching it.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: pixel-transition
items.title: Pixel Transition
items.description: Swap what is shown through a wall of pixels. Blocks cover the old content in dither order, the way old computers dissolved between screens, the content changes behind them, and they clear the same way. No JavaScript animation.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: print-transition
items.title: Print Transition
items.description: One picture prints over another. Change the src and the new image arrives as a halftone screen: dots grow across the old one in a sweep, a bloom from the centre or a scatter, until they merge into the whole picture.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: print
items.title: Print
items.description: A photograph printed the way a press prints it. The picture is split into cyan, magenta, yellow and black, and each ink is laid down as its own screen of dots at its own angle, so the dots grow, merge and leave rosettes. Edges are a little ragged, the plates sit slightly out of register, and the paper has tooth. The pointer is a loupe.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive Blur
items.description: A blur that gets stronger towards an edge, and a scroll area that wears one at each end: the ends blur and dissolve only while there is more to scroll that way. CSS only, on any background.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: risograph
items.title: Risograph
items.description: A photograph printed in two spot inks on a stencil duplicator. Each ink is worked out so the two together come as close to the picture as they can, then laid down as fine grain with patches where the ink ran thin. The plates sit out of register, and the pointer drags them further apart.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A box that ticks. The check draws itself in, and a parent checkbox shows a dash when only some of its children are on.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, a control, a hint and an error, wired together. The label names the control, the hint describes it, and the error appears under it with a short settle when something is wrong.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: The form that holds the fields. It validates with the browser’s own rules, shows errors where they belong, takes errors back from your server, and hands you the values as an object.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input and a textarea that grows as you write. Quiet at rest, lifted on focus, red when wrong.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: A number you can type, step with the buttons, or nudge with the arrow keys, kept inside its limits.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Pick one of a few. The chosen ring fills and a dot grows from its centre.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choose one option from a list. The trigger looks like an input; when there is room the list opens over it with the chosen option sitting where the trigger was, like a native menu on a Mac, and otherwise just below it.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on and off that takes effect at once. The thumb slides across and stretches a little while you hold it.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: auth-diagram
items.title: Authentication
items.description: Three ways to sign in on the left, one check in the middle, your app on the right. Each turn a different method sends a signal, the lock becomes a tick that draws itself, and the app opens.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: bot-face
items.title: Bot Face
items.description: Two eyes on a coloured panel. They drift, glance around, blink now and then, follow the pointer, and squish and wink when clicked. Runs only while on screen.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: diagram-glyphs
items.title: Diagram Glyphs
items.description: Sixteen marks drawn by hand for Diagram tiles on a 24 unit grid, in a line style and a solid style: app, database, mail, card, chart, key, phone, shield, bank, receipt, coin, check, cloud, user and bolt.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: diagram
items.title: Diagram
items.description: The parts the illustrations are made from: tiles, routes with ports, and a signal that travels them, all on one clock. Lay out your own in a few lines, with the glyph set or any icons you already use.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: folder
items.title: Folder
items.description: A blue folder standing upright, three dark sheets standing out of it behind a frosted front pocket. On hover the pocket tips forward and each sheet rises and fans out on its own.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: integrations-diagram
items.title: Integrations
items.description: Your app in the middle and four services around it, joined by routes with small ports. An event comes in along one route, the app lights up, and the answer goes out along the others. Put your own marks on the tiles.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: payments-diagram
items.title: Payments
items.description: A card is charged, the payment clears, and three things follow: the money goes to the bank, a receipt goes out and your app is told. The coin turns into a tick while it all happens.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-app
items.title: App
items.description: An app window with a sidebar and three panels. The panels lift off toward you in layers, then settle back.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-bolt
items.title: Bolt
items.description: A lightning bolt raised on a rounded tile. It lifts off the tile while a ring spreads beneath it, then settles.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-camera
items.title: Camera
items.description: A camera with a zoom lens, a dial and a flash. It zooms out, focuses, blinks its timer twice, fires and zooms back in.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-card
items.title: Card
items.description: Two payment cards, one on the other. The top card lifts and tilts as if tapped while its contactless mark pulses.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: A bar chart on a plate. The bars grow to new values one after another while the trend line rides their tops.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A processor with four pins a side. A light runs round the pins, then the die lifts and lights.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-cloud
items.title: Cloud
items.description: A cloud of three lobes on a flat base. Three dashes rise from below into it, one after another.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-database
items.title: Database
items.description: Three disks stacked into a database. They part, their lights go round once and a ring pulses off the top before they settle.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-envelope
items.title: Envelope
items.description: An envelope on its edge, flap and seal facing you. The flap swings up and back, and a letter rises out and sinks again.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-folder
items.title: Folder
items.description: A file folder with three sheets inside. The cover tips open and the sheets rise one after another, then settle.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-gears
items.title: Gears
items.description: Two meshed gears lying flat. The large one turns three teeth and the small one follows the other way.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-key
items.title: Key
items.description: A key lying flat. It lifts, turns a quarter as if in a lock, turns back and sets down.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-laptop
items.title: Laptop
items.description: An open laptop with code on its screen. The code backspaces away and types back in, the cursor holding while it types.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-padlock
items.title: Padlock
items.description: A padlock with a keyhole and a shackle. The key turns, the shackle pops up and swings open, then it closes and locks.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-phone
items.title: Phone
items.description: A phone with a notification above a grid of apps. The notification rises away and a new one drops in.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-server
items.title: Server
items.description: Three rack units in a stack. Lights chase up the stack while the middle unit slides out on its rails and back.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-shield
items.title: Shield
items.description: A shield with a raised face and a check. It lifts while the check clears and draws itself again.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-speaker
items.title: Speaker
items.description: A speaker cabinet with a woofer and a tweeter. Three beats push the cone out, each sending an arc from both sides.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-stopwatch
items.title: Stopwatch
items.description: A stopwatch with a small dial for minutes. The crown starts it, the hand sweeps two turns, and the crown stops it.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A switch on a plate. The knob slides across, the track lights, and it slides back off.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric-workflow
items.title: Workflow
items.description: Three steps on a plate, joined by routes with ports. A packet runs from step to step, and each lights as it arrives.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: isometric
items.title: Isometric
items.description: The engine behind the isometric drawings: solids drawn as thin coloured lines with a slight pen wobble, posed, and played on hover. Each drawing installs it.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: pixel-reveal
items.title: Pixel Reveal
items.description: An image that resolves out of big pixels. It arrives as a handful of coloured blocks and sharpens in steps, each one halving the blocks, until it is the picture. A real image sits underneath the whole time.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: video-hero
items.title: Video Hero
items.description: A banner for a show or a launch: the episode plays behind the words, blurred to a glow that fades to black at the sides. On top sit a title, a line about it, one clear button that opens the player, and the ways to follow along.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video Player
items.description: A silent, looping preview that opens into a near full screen player. The player has the title and a link along the top, one row of controls along the bottom, a line you can scrub, and every key you would expect. It all gets out of the way while you watch.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Rows that open to show more. One thing moves: the panel’s height, on one short clock both ways, so rows trading places leave everything below them still and nothing creeps into place at the end. The plus turns into a minus on the same clock. Built on Base UI, animated in CSS.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button that feels like an object: light on its surface, a shadow that deepens under the pointer and closes up when pressed, a quick press and a slow release. Busy and done states swap in softly without the button changing width. Built on Base UI, animated in CSS.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A soft tray around a raised surface, with concentric corners. As a link its surface lifts on hover and sinks on press, and its media breathes; it does not jump at the pointer.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A dialog built like the card: what you read sits on a raised surface, what you press sits under it on the tray. It comes towards you in 250ms and is gone in 150. Built on Base UI, animated in CSS.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A text link whose underline is drawn on the text: it draws in from the left, leaves to the right, and follows the words when they wrap. Four treatments, hover and keyboard alike, no JavaScript.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A menu of actions that grows out of the button that opened it and is gone the moment you choose. Items, ticks, choices, groups and key hints. Built on Base UI, animated in CSS.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: squircle-card
items.title: Squircle Card
items.description: The Card with continuous corners. A plain squircle at the same radius looks sharper, so the radius grows by the depth a circle cuts divided by the depth the curve cuts, ×1.84 for a squircle; the corners line up with the round ones they replace and the nested gap stays even. Uses CSS corner-shape inside @supports, so browsers without it keep the regular round Card.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs whose selected chip tightens under a press, stretches towards the tab you pick, then gathers itself, with panels that drift in from the same side. A raised chip in a tray, or a sliding underline. Built on Base UI, animated in CSS.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short message that rises in from just below where it rests, out of a slight blur, and leaves the same small way. Newer toasts stack in front and older ones tuck in behind, a little smaller and dimmer; hover the stack to spread it out. When a toast changes, its words and icon morph in place. A pill variant puts the whole message on one dark line, and a single manager makes each new message take the place of the last. Built on Base UI, animated in CSS.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of controls that act on one thing: buttons, toggles, a choice of one, a link or an input. Arrow keys move between them, and where you pick one of a few the highlight glides between them.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small label for a control. Give a row of controls one tooltip between them and it stays open as you move along: the label glides to the next control, changes width to fit, and the words dissolve from one to the next. Built on Base UI, animated in CSS.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: verified-badge
items.title: Verified Badge
items.description: The scalloped check that sits after a name. A soft glint passes over it every couple of seconds, and stays still for anyone who prefers less motion.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Anything that arrives as it scrolls into view: a card, a paragraph, a section. It fades, rises a little and sharpens into focus; groups go one after another from a single trigger, and nothing inside is touched. No JavaScript animation.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: dot-matrix
items.title: Dot Matrix
items.description: Text on a dot matrix, five dots wide and seven tall, like a departure board. Unlit dots stay faintly visible, and when the text changes the dots that differ flip in a wave from the left. No JavaScript animation.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: echo-text
items.title: Echo Text
items.description: Type with depth. Copies of the word stack behind it, each a step further back and a shade closer to the page, cut apart by a hairline of the page colour so the stack reads as a solid extrusion. They slide out from behind the word one after another. Pure CSS.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: highlight
items.title: Highlight
items.description: A mark made over a word or a phrase: a highlighter that wraps with the text, or a pen stroke under, around or round a word. Each is drawn when it comes into view. No JavaScript animation.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: ink-bleed
items.title: Ink Bleed
items.description: Words that soak into the page. The ink arrives as a soft, ragged stain and draws itself together into crisp letters, the way ink spreads into paper and settles. The filter is removed once it has landed, so the text renders as plain text.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: letter-swap
items.title: Letter Swap
items.description: On hover each letter slides out and a copy slides in, one after another, optionally into a different word. Pure CSS: the stagger plays forward on enter and back on leave, and can be interrupted anywhere.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: number-roll
items.title: Number Roll
items.description: A number whose digits roll to their new value. Each digit is a reel behind a soft-edged window: it rolls the way the number moved, streaks while it is fast, and digits fold in and out when the number changes length.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Text that resolves out of noise. A sweep crosses the string at a steady rate; characters behind it are final, characters ahead of it churn. Decoding, not glitching.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: signature
items.title: Signature
items.description: Draws a signature, or any hand-drawn SVG, stroke by stroke at a steady pen speed, lifting between strokes. Pen centrelines are stroked; filled outlines are revealed as ink along their own path.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: split-text
items.title: Split Text
items.description: Splits a string into words and characters you can style one by one. Words still wrap, spaces stay real, screen readers hear the sentence, and every piece knows its index, word and measured line.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: sweep-text
items.title: Sweep Text
items.description: A band of colour sweeps across the text and leaves it written behind it. Give it several lines and it moves on to the next after each sweep, the width easing to fit. The colours ride on the text itself, so it sits inside any heading.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Text that arrives piece by piece: characters, words or lines. Each one fades, lifts a little and sharpens from a slight blur, so it reads as settling into focus. Pure CSS, no animation library.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: text-swap
items.title: Text Swap
items.description: Change a word without it blinking. The old word lifts away and blurs out as the new one rises in, and the space between them stretches to fit, so nothing beside it jumps.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types a list of phrases one after another, without the harshness: letters fade in and sharpen instead of popping, the rhythm is a little uneven like a person’s, and a finished phrase fades out as one instead of being backspaced.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: delete-button
items.title: Delete Button
items.description: A delete button you press and hold. A solid red fill sweeps in under a feathered edge, turning the label white as it passes, while the bin’s lid opens; let go early and it runs back, hold to the end and it deletes, shows a spinner while your promise runs, then a drawn check. Holding is the confirmation, so there is no dialog.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A pill that changes shape to fit what it is showing. Give it a view key and some content: it glides to the new size from rest, taking longer for longer trips, and dissolves what is inside. Larger views sit on a raised card surface that grows with it. No animation library.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: expandable-tabs
items.title: Expandable Tabs
items.description: An icon bar whose active tab says its name, and whose page grows out of the bar. The label, the highlight and the shell move as one, on one clock. No animation library.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: like-button
items.title: Like Button
items.description: A heart that fills, dips and springs back when liked, throwing a spray of dots that lands differently every time, while the count rolls up. Unliking drains it quietly.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: panel-menu
items.title: Panel Menu
items.description: A menu built from stacked glass panels. Closed, it is a single bar. Open, the label flips, a tall body wipes down beneath it, and the link and language rows settle in after. Built on Base UI, animated in CSS.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: prediction-market
items.title: Prediction Market
items.description: An order ticket for a yes or no market. Pick an outcome and a side, type an amount, and the shares, the payout and the return roll to their new values. Built from the card, the tabs, the button and the rolling numbers.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: stamp
items.title: Stamp
items.description: A rubber stamp for a decision: approved, paid, sent. The ink is worn in places, the frame is doubled, and it lands with a short press, from a little above and out of focus, without a bounce.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: tick-slider
items.title: Tick Slider
items.description: A scroll progress indicator you can scrub. A slim red needle runs along a tray of hairline ticks as the page scrolls, and dragging the needle scrolls the page. Built on Base UI, animated in CSS.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-content-height
items.title: Use Content Height
items.description: The live height of an element's content, for a container that animates its height to fit as the content opens, closes or grows. Includes a settled flag so a section that starts open does not animate in.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-data-grid-filters
items.title: Use Data Grid Filters
items.description: Holds the Data Grid's filters and the actions that change them, keeping each operator in step with how many values it has. Works out every column's options, counts and number range from the rows, or takes them from a server. Renders nothing, so the same state can drive a table, a query or a URL.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-debounced-callback
items.title: Use Debounced Callback
items.description: Wraps a callback so it runs once the calls stop for a given time, always with the newest arguments and the newest callback. A call still waiting when the component unmounts runs then, so the last keystroke before a popover closes is not lost.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-entrance
items.title: Use Entrance
items.description: Decides when a CSS entrance plays: a frame after mount, or when the element scrolls into view. Returns a boolean to put on a data attribute; includes a small useInView.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-latest
items.title: Use Latest
items.description: A ref that always holds the newest value of a prop or callback, updated after each render. Lets an effect or a subscription call the latest callback without re-running whenever its identity changes.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-merged-ref
items.title: Use Merged Ref
items.description: Points several refs at one element, so a component can keep its own ref and still honour the one passed to it. Supports object refs, callback refs and React 19 ref cleanups.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-outgoing
items.title: Use Outgoing
items.description: Keeps the content that was just replaced for the length of its exit, so it can fade out in CSS while the new content fades in. Give it a key and what is shown under that key; it returns the previous pair until the duration has passed.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-picture
items.title: Use Picture
items.description: Loads an image for WebGL with CORS, and hands it back only once it has loaded and only while it is still the image asked for, so a slow old picture never replaces a new one.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-raking-light
items.title: Use Raking Light
items.description: Turns the pointer into a low lamp: writes --shade-x and --shade-y on an element, the direction its shadow falls, from anywhere on the page. Rests lit from the top left, ignores touch and reduced motion.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: Use Reduced Motion
items.description: Whether the visitor has asked for reduced motion, as a boolean that is safe to read while rendering: false on the server and during hydration, then the real setting, and it updates if the setting changes.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-scroll-progress
items.title: Use Scroll Progress
items.description: How far the page, or a scroll container, has been scrolled, from 0 to 1, kept current as it scrolls or resizes, with a setter that scrolls it to a fraction. Vertical by default. Pairs content with a progress indicator or a scrubber.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: use-shader
items.title: Use Shader
items.description: Runs a full-screen WebGL 2 fragment shader on a canvas: builds it off the main thread where the browser can, sizes it to a pixel budget, draws only while it is on screen and something is changing, eases the pointer, re-reads colours when the theme changes, and survives a lost context.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: bayer
items.title: Bayer
items.description: The 8 by 8 Bayer matrix behind ordered dithering, as a threshold from 0 to 1 for any pixel. Compare a brightness with it to decide whether that pixel is on.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid-export
items.title: Data Grid Export
items.description: Gets data out of the Data Grid as the user sees it: CSV with spreadsheet-safe quoting, tab-separated text for the clipboard, and a print window that holds every row instead of the few a virtual list has mounted.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid-features
items.title: Data Grid Features
items.description: The TanStack Table features the Data Grid is built on, registered once, with the table, column and row types every part of the grid is written against and the per-column meta the grid reads.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: data-grid-filters
items.title: Data Grid Filters
items.description: The logic under the Data Grid's filter bar: the five data types a column can be filtered as, the operators each one takes and how they negate and widen, the function that tests a value against a filter, and the bridge that hands the filters to TanStack Table.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: glsl
items.title: Glsl
items.description: The shared start of every Mizzle background shader: standard uniforms, integer hashing that draws the same on every GPU, gradient noise, OKLab to screen colour with gamut fitting, dither and film grain. Also reads any CSS colour, variables included, as sRGB or OKLab.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: picture
items.title: Picture
items.description: Puts a photograph into a WebGL 2 texture with mipmaps, and the GLSL that goes with it: sRGB decoding, cover fitting like object-fit, rotation, and a pointer loupe that magnifies what is under it.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>

items.name: speckle
items.title: Speckle
items.description: A tiling mask of fine paper noise as a CSS url(), for ink that did not take everywhere: letterpress, stamps, worn prints.
items.author: mizzle <https://mizzle.saddy.me>
